semantics: Only visible Research Agent text is streamed; memory summaries and tool arguments are excluded.
Partial text is checkpointed separately and survives refresh/disconnection.
Reconnecting uses an authoritative snapshot and never resubmits the turn.
Cancellation or upstream failure leaves partial text explicitly labelled and excludes it from completed conversation memory.
Final answer, normalized result links and memory commit together only after the workflow completion envelope validates.
limitations: Time to first text depends on model generation, tool execution and any required memory compression; measurements are observations from these test turns, not latency guarantees.
A model summary can fail existing length validation; the tested failure preserved old memory and raw history, and a subsequent test turn completed three compression passes successfully.
Streaming was verified through the live frontend proxy and local browser. External reverse proxies must honor X-Accel-Buffering: no or disable buffering on the stream route.
